verdict.rationale: Databricks SQL documents native ANSI SQL support with Delta Lake extensions and a built-in SQL editor. This implies a standard analytical surface (CTEs, window functions) without bolt-ons, but the pack never names any of the specific features in the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of window functions, CTEs, semi-structured JSON handling, array types/functions, rich date/time types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SQL breadth.
